intellectual.sub_intellectual_2: A post-secondary team works with Bunker Hill, UMass Boston and Roxbury Community College, running Community Connect hubs on campus and monitoring grades with consent.

occupational.sub_occupational_1: Summer internships posted on Future Boss; the PIC funds community-based roles and handles onboarding and payroll so employers can focus on training.
occupational.sub_occupational_2: A career specialist sits in every Boston public high school, and coaching continues after placement, including mediating misunderstandings with new managers.
occupational.sub_occupational_3: Career specialists in each Boston public high school help students build a first resume and understand what city employers look for.
occupational.sub_occupational_4: Career-readiness programs at ABCD Boston and MassHire Downtown covering soft skills and personality assessments, plus ESL classes and tracks for youth with disabilities.

financial.sub_financial_1: Career coaches are trained in budgeting, taxes and monthly expenses, and refer young adults to the Roxbury Financial Empowerment Center for hands-on plans.
financial.sub_financial_2: Support completing the FAFSA correctly and finding scholarships, with the goal of graduating with as little debt as possible.
financial.sub_financial_3: Workshops for parents on saving for a home or college tuition, plus Financially Lit with The Possible Zone, aimed at young fathers.

social.sub_social_1: Community Connect pairs students with a mentor in the same major, matched by an interests survey, which raises on-time graduation rates.
